proof_status: Forty-five maintained kernel-checked modules: local G2 and Sp4 models, complete Jacobi readouts, actual diagonal-curve and full Fermat-septic counting bridges, all-residue Frobenius compression, and the full principal-compensated cubic Fermat observation with its nontrivial joint Abel limit. Actual character fibers, inverse-pair and infinity corrections are proved. Projective geometry, prime-power lifting, rational-prime descent and global automorphic transfer remain separate. No analytic boundary gain. The Paley phase sector has a sharp uniform cubic-source stability theorem, exact positive-polynomial certificate and symbolic noncoherent attainer. The sharp unrestricted three-phase inequality and general arithmetic sector-membership transfer remain open. The complete cyclic correlation problem now has a kernel-checked constant-eight stability inequality, uniformly through the high-maximum range. Source-field Gauss Frobenius and the positive unit normalization now discharge the Paley-sector conditions for p modulo7 equal2 or4 with a Frobenius-invariant primitive additive character; the sharp signed actual Fermat point-count bound is proved. The scalar two-moment region 1<M<=1+2*sqrt(2) is formally controlled at the proposed sharp constant; the proposed sharp high-maximum bound remains open; the global constant-eight cyclic bound is proved. An explicit two-peak vector disproves extension from the first two moments alone and has cyclic correlation98/5, so it does not obstruct the actual phase problem. The full unit-circle Laurent certificate, cubic phase-gap bound and two-sided conditional arithmetic consumer are maintained and kernel checked. Prime-field nonzero anti-invariant and product separation remain open; no global exponent gain. Prime-norm septic cyclotomic nonvanishing and the same-orbit complete beta-product nonzero theorem are maintained and kernel checked. Actual Jacobi integer-coefficient transport and integral anti-invariant assembly remain open. A single natural counting profile with exact nonzero-support mass represents all positive power probes for arbitrary cover degree n, over any commutative semiring with decidable equality. This finite counting adapter is not an analytic gain or a novelty claim.

frobenius.scope: Every finite field of prime characteristic p with an actual order-seven character; complex-valued Jacobi sums. Source consumer retains primitive AddChar, rho^2=q and nonzero auxiliary scale.
frobenius.identity: J(chi^p,phi^p)=J(chi,phi), by reindexing the source field. Therefore J_(p*r)=J_r modulo seven.
frobenius.packet: Product_(r=1..6)(U+J_r*V)=R_p(U,V)^f, with one factor per orbit and f=1,3,6,3,6,2.
frobenius.all_signed_power_traces: For every natural n, sum_(r=1..6)(-J_r)^n=f*sum_(orbit representatives)(-J_r)^n.
frobenius.complete_source_consumer: P_native(U,rho*V/u^15)=R_p(U,V)^f at the balanced corner; every native factor and cross term retained.
frobenius.vanishing_branch: For every finite field with card(F)%7 not equal to 1, seventh powering is bijective and N_aff=card(F), with no character assumption.
frobenius.exceptions: Characteristic seven is included only in the non-split affine count, and excluded from the tame source and good genus-three interpretation. Characteristic two uses the Kummer model.
frobenius.descent_status: The fth-power factorization is over the field containing order-seven characters. A rational-prime numerator requires compatible prime-power counts and geometric/lifting inputs; it is not yet a Lean theorem.

fermat_readout.field_domain: Every finite field with an actual order-seven complex multiplicative character. The source bridge additionally takes a primitive AddChar, nonzero rho with rho^2=q, and arbitrary nonzero u.
fermat_readout.actual_counts: N_aff=# {(x,y):x^7+y^7=1}; N_chart=N_aff+# {z:z^7=-1}, the two canonical projective normal forms.
fermat_readout.complete_character_count: N_aff=q+sum_(r,s=1..6)J(chi^r,chi^s). All 36 terms are retained first.
fermat_readout.endpoint_corrections: Exactly six inverse-pair Jacobi sums equal -1; there are exactly seven infinity points. Thus N_chart=q+1+S_30.
fermat_readout.phase_identity: S_30/rho=sum_(i=0..7)m_i*phase_i, where m_i=3 or6; 18 repeated-entry and 12 residue-triple contributions.
fermat_readout.full_observable: Q_full(a)=1+PC-(D*coherentProjection_all(a))^3. Both full periods are multiplied out before cubing. The finite form replaces D*coherentProjection_all by torusProjection_all.
fermat_readout.assembly: After averaging, Q_full-1 equals the sum over all eight masked mean-minus-one readouts with exact multiplicities. This is the complete single-twist cubic observation, not a product of separate averages.
fermat_readout.abel_consumer: The normalized (mean(Q_full_coherent)-1)/u^15 tends to (q+1-N_chart)/rho as radial r approaches1 from below. The filter is nontrivial and both complete period series converge for0<=r<1.
fermat_readout.nonsplit_branch: If q%7 is not1, seventh powering is bijective, N_aff=q and N_chart=q+1, with no character hypothesis.
fermat_readout.small_characteristics: No division by2 is used. The nonsplit chart-count identity includes characteristic7 as a possibly singular count; the tame metaplectic source and smooth genus15 interpretation exclude characteristic7.
fermat_readout.classical_geometry: The two normal forms identify the count of X^7+Y^7=Z^7. Its smooth geometry and classical Fermat-Jacobian decomposition are not new Lean geometry theorems.
fermat_readout.normalization_cost: Physical u=q^(-1/14): normalized trace extraction still costs q^(15/14). No global analytic exponent gain.
fermat_readout.novelty: Classical Jacobi/Fermat counting and Jacobian decompositions are inputs/context. Priority of the complete compensated G2 source-to-Fermat observation is not established.
